name: Arcane Trickster
desc: Arcane Trickster: a rogue subclass. Hand-written summary, not the book text.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.desc: Cast wizard spells (enchantment and illusion mostly). Intelligence is your spell ability.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.desc: Your mage hand is invisible. It can pick pockets and open locks.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.desc: A target has disadvantage on saves against your spell when you are hidden.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.desc: Use mage hand to give yourself advantage against a creature.

features.name: Spell Thief
features.desc: Steal a spell that a creature casts at you, and cast it yourself.
